title: GOD OF JACOB, CHANGE MY NAME AND DESTINY TONIGHT
text: Hear me tonight. There are moments in destiny when God must step in and rewrite the script of a man's life. Jacob was a struggler, a suppler, a man marked by limitation. But one encounter, one encounter shifted him from Jacob to Israel, from a struggler to a prince with God. I prophesy over someone here tonight, may this be your night of encounter. The God of Jacob will change your name and your destiny tonight in the name of Jesus. >> For too long, many of you have been identified with pain, with failure, with rejection. But hear me, in the spirit, names represent verdicts and identities. When God changes your name, he changes your story. Tonight is not a counseling session. It is a prophetic destiny exchange. As Jacob wrestled with God and prevailed, so will you wrestle in prayer tonight and your story will never remain the same. Lift up your voice and cry. Oh God of Jacob, change my name. Change my destiny. Take away reproach. Take away delay. Take away baroness. Take away shame. destiny is shifting right now. Names are changing in the realm of the spirit. Someone here they call you rejected but heaven is calling you accepted. They call you barren but God is calling you fruitful. They call you poor but heaven is giving you the name kingdom financier. Listen at this point I don't want you to pray alone. I want you to sing this song with me from the depth of your heart. The title of the song is I believe I shall see the goodness of the Lord. As you sing it, let it be a prophetic declaration over your life. >> I believe I shall see the goodness of the Lord. >> Pray, pray, pray. Destiny is shifting. Cry onto God. Jacob did not keep silent. He wrestled tonight. Wrestle in prayer until your destiny changes. Don't be afraid. >> The Lord is my light. The Lord is my salvation. In him I will trust. I will not be afraid. Sing it like a prophecy over your life tonight. I believe. I shall see the goodness of the Lord. Yes, that's it. As you sing, God is rewriting your destiny. As you sing, chains are breaking. As you sing, angels of destiny are realigning your life. Tonight, Jacob is becoming Israel. In the mighty name of Jesus, say after me, in the name of Jesus, I declare my name is changing. My destiny is shifting. My story is rewritten. No more Jacob. From tonight I am Israel. Lift your voice and blast in the spirit. [Music] Roar. Beloved, tonight we are gathered under a prophetic atmosphere. And I sense strongly in my spirit that this is not an ordinary night. There are nights where heaven invades the earth, where angels are released on assignment, and where the verdicts of destiny are shifted forever. Tonight is one of those nights. The God of Jacob is about to encounter men and women, change their names, and alter the course of their destinies. Genesis 32:24-28 says, "And Jacob was left alone, and there wrestled a man with him until the breaking of the day. And when he saw that he prevailed not against him, he touched the hollow of his thigh. And the hollow of Jacob's thigh was out of joint as he wrestled with him. And he said, Let me go, for the day breakth. And he said, I will not let thee go except thou bless me. And he said unto him, What is thy name? And he said, Jacob. And he said, "Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel, for as a prince has thou power with God and with men, and hast prevailed." Hear me. A name is not just a label. It is a prophecy. Names in scripture carry destiny, carry verdicts, and carry covenants. Jacob meant suppler, deceiver, a man marked by struggle and manipulation. But in one encounter, the God of heaven changed his identity and gave him a prophetic destiny, Israel, a prince with God, one who prevails. That same God is here tonight. The God of Jacob will change your name. The God of Jacob will alter your destiny. The God of Jacob will silence every voice of reproach and replace it with a new identity of glory. Some of you have been tied to names of shame, names of limitation, names of baroness, names of failure. Some families are called the poor family, the barren family, the sickly family. But tonight, by the power of the blood of Jesus, those names are changing. Isaiah 62:2 says, "And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory, and thou shalt be called by a new name." Isaiah 65:15 declares, "And ye shall leave your name for a cause unto my chosen, for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name. I decree and declare the name of reproach, the name of curses, the name of stagnation is left behind tonight by fire and by power. You are called by another name. Thus sayeth the Lord, there are people here who have been wrestling secretly with the cycles of Jacob, cycles of manipulation, cycles of delay, cycles of restlessness. But tonight I will touch you. Though it may leave a mark, it will also leave a mantle. Your limp will become your testimony. Your scars will become proof that you prevail with God. I decree and declare every evil label the enemy has put on your life is erased. Every demonic handwriting in the spirit that identifies you for evil is wiped away by the blood. Colossians 2:14 says, "Blottting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross." Tonight, every ordinance of darkness against you is nailed to the cross. Now pray with fire. Oh God of Jacob, change my destiny. Where there has been delay, let speed come. Where there has been shame, let honor come. Where there has been lack, let abundance come. Where there has been sickness, let healing come. Where there has been captivity, let deliverance come. I decree and declare the God of Jacob, who changed the name of Abraham to Abraham, the name of Sarai to Sarah, the name of Simon to Peter, is changing your name now. Your name will be synonymous with favor. Your name will be synonymous with breakthrough. Your name will be synonymous with victory. Psalm 126 1-2 says, "When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream. Then was our mouth filled with laughter and our tongue with singing. Then said they among the heathen, the Lord has done great things for them. By this scripture, I decree that people will look at you and say, "The Lord has done great things for you." Tonight, the enemies who mocked you will regret tonight. The powers that held you bound will let you go. Tonight, the voice of the blood of Jesus will speak louder than the voice of accusation. Tonight, God himself will inscribe a new identity over your head. I decree and declare your destiny is rebranded by heaven. Your life is rewritten by fire. Your story is retold by grace. Every trace of the old is erased. The new has come. Amen. Beloved, as we continue, I sense the spirit of the Lord pressing me to lead us into deeper warfare. This is not a night for casual prayer. This is a night where destinies are violently shifted. The scripture says in Matthew 11:12, "And from the days of John the Baptist until now, the kingdom of heaven suffered violence, and the violent take it by force." Tonight, we engage the violence of the spirit. We contend for a name change. We contend for a destiny shift. We contend for the verdicts of heaven to overrule the voices of hell. Lift your hands and say, "Father, every verdict of darkness over my life, let it be overturned tonight. Every voice calling my name in evil shrines. Every voice calling my family in covens tonight by the blood of Jesus, I silence them. Evil altars thrive on names. They call your name for affliction. They call your name for delay. They call your name for sickness. But tonight, the fire of God answers them. 1 Kings 18:38 says, "Then the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burn sacrifice and the wood and the stones and the dust and licked up the water that was in the trench. Let fire fall and consume every altar where your name is called for evil." Pray now with intensity. By the fire of the Holy Ghost, I scatter every altar where my name has been taken. Oh God of Jacob, change my name and silence evil altars. Every altar of poverty, every altar of delay, every altar of sickness, every altar of untimely death, catch fire now in the name of Jesus. I decree and declare your name is being removed from demonic registers. Your name is being removed from satanic books of I stand by the authority of Psalm 68:1. Let God arise. Let his enemies be scattered. Let them also that hate him flee before him. Every enemy that has vowed you will not rise. I decree they scatter by fire. Scatter the enemies of my health. Scatter the enemies of my lifting. Oh God of Jacob, arise. I decree and declare. Chains are breaking. Yols are destroyed. Evil names are erased. The spirit of stagnation is broken. The God of Jacob is renaming you tonight. Where they call you rejected, you will be called celebrated. Where they call you barren, you will be called fruitful. Where they call you beggar, you will be called lender. Where they call you sick, you will be called healed. Isaiah 62:4 says, "Thou shalt no more be tempted forsaken, neither shall thy land anymore be termed desolate, but thou shalt be called hea, and thy land puler. For the Lord delightth in thee, and thy land shall be married." I decree that scripture becomes your reality tonight. No more forsaken, no more desolate. You are called the delight of the Lord. Beloved, lift your hands in worship. Thank you, Father, because you are renaming me. Thank you because my story is changing. Thank you because my captivity is turning. Thank you because my destiny is being rewritten by fire. Now I prophesy, everyone under the sound of my voice, before this year ends, people will look at you and say, "What happened to you? Tonight is not an ordinary night. It is a prophetic night. The God of Jacob is here. The same God who turned Jacob into Israel, and he is ready to turn your story around. By the blood your health is redeemed from destruction. Now hear me. There are forces that resist men when they are close to breakthrough. These forces ensure that at the edge of success something always goes wrong. But tonight we declare Isaiah 59:19. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him. Every power that rises against your breakthrough, let the spirit of the Lord lift a standard now. Pray with fire. Father, I refuse to fail at the edge of breakthrough. Every evil spirit assigned to scatter my testimony, catch fire now. Every monitoring eye watching my progress, go blind in the name of Jesus. every evil hand stretched against my destiny. The reason you have labored with little result is because your name has been tied to hardship. But tonight, by my fire, I release you. Your name is rewritten in the heavens. Your destiny is released into abundance. Receive it in the mighty name of Jesus. Lift your hands and pray. Father, change my name from failure to success. Change my name from rejected to accepted. Change my name from barren to fruitful. Change my name from sick to healed. Change my name from oppressed to delivered. Change my name from broke to prosperous. Change my name from forgotten to celebrated. I decree over you, you shall laugh the laughter of victory. You shall sing the songs of deliverance. Angels of deliverance, angels of breakthrough, angels of vengeance, move now. Fight for the people of God, scatter evil altars, reverse arrows, break chains, loose destinies. I decree by fire every evil stronghold binding your life, binding your family, binding your finances, binding your health, break now, fall now, scatter now in the name of Jesus.
